status: provisional static regression reference, not hardware timing approval
limits: unchanged +10% comparison; both total instructions and loop cost; inherited budgets unchanged

cadence.drone_tick: per track/block; walk at its control cadence
cadence.drone_voice: per active voice/block; straight-line body is nonzero even when loop cost is zero

limitations: Calls are counted but not recursively costed. Static backward-branch weights are not cycles; inlining and unrolling can change this proxy independently of runtime. Verify emitted target code and hardware worst-case timing before release.
